analysis_md:
由
$$
\begin{cases}
x\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}+y\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+s=0\\
x+r\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+s\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=0
\end{cases}
$$
解得：
$$
\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}=\frac{x^2-s^2}{sy-xr}
$$

设 $x=x(r,s),y=y(r,s)$ 由 $xy+rs=1,xr+ys=1$ 确定，求 $x_r$。 $\frac{x^2+s^2}{sy-xr}$ $\frac{x^2-s^2}{sy-xr}$ $\frac{x^2+s^2}{sy+xr}$ $\frac{x^2-s^2}{sy+xr}$ 由
$$
\begin{cases}
x\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}+y\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+s=0\\
x+r\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}+s\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=0
\end{cases}
$$
解得：
$$
\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}=\frac{x^2-s^2}{sy-xr}
$$
